extension.description: Unified syntax highlighting pack: every VSCode built-in grammar plus additions, synced from pinned upstreams.
configuration.title: Poly Syntax Highlight
config.updateCheck.enabled.description: Periodically check GitHub Releases for a new poly-syntax-highlight, and install a new one without asking; only the window reload is left to you. An update also installs Poly (poly-lsp) when it is installed, and a release one of the two already installed in this window is not installed again.
config.updateCheck.intervalDays.descript: Days between this extension's automatic update checks; 0 checks on every startup. Separate from Poly's own poly.updateCheck.intervalDays.
